text:
anna: Heads-up — prototype UX for adaptive fallback prioritization. Thinking we expose a slider for 'priority weight' per fallback target and a rule preview that shows estimated requests that will be rerouted. Thoughts?
raj: Love the preview idea. Can the preview show latency/cost delta per target? e.g., 'Fallback -> small-gpt-q4 (quantized) — +12ms, -60% cost'
maria: yes please. Also need audit trail: who changed weights and rollout window. We should reuse existing rollout audit modal.
jordan: quick note: slider alone is risky. Need explicit numeric input + confirmation for >50% changes. Ops had incidents when someone toggled too far.
anna: Agreed. Mockup attached — https://intra/mockups/fallback-priority. Key elements: slider + numeric input + preview histogram + 'simulate 10k qps' button.
raj: Simulation button is huge. Can we make it sample-based? simulate 10k qps could be expensive, but a statistical sampler with scaled-up estimates should work.
maria: Proposed minimal config snippet for the API + console to persist: 
```
fallbacks:
  - id: small-gpt-q4
    weight: 0.2
    triggers:
      - error_rate > 0.05
      - latency.p95 > 120ms
    canary_percent: 10
    auto_revert_after: 10m
```
jordan: Also show impact on SLOs in preview. If fallback routes 30% of traffic to small-gpt, what happens to p50/p95? display expected changes and a confidence interval.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Simulation started: run_id=sim-8623 — ETA ~2m
anna: For audit, propose these fields: author, change, prev_weight, new_weight, reason, simulate_run_id. Anything missing?
raj: Add 'approval_required' boolean and 'notified_on_change' list. Also store the sample prompts used for simulation.
maria: +1 on sample prompts. We should tag them with evaluation ids so we can replay quality checks later.
jordan: UX nit: put 'safety guardrails' section under the slider with toggles: 'require approval', 'auto-revert', 'notify-on-change'. If 'require approval' is on, greys out big changes until approved.
anna: Ok actionable: I'll update mock to include numeric input, simulate button, audit metadata, guardrail toggles, and a compact SLO impact card. @raj @maria @jordan — can you review by EOD? :thumbsup:
raj: on it
maria: will do
jordan: yep
ops-bot: [audit-log] created entry sim-8623 by anna
anna: Thanks — quick follow-up question: Should the console expose an advanced panel for weighting expressions? e.g., ability to give multiple fallbacks priorities that sum to 1 using expressions like `weight = base * (1 - quality_penalty)`. Might be useful for power users.
raj: I think power users will want it, but default must stay simple. Maybe fold advanced under 'expressions' with playground.
maria: If we add expressions, require server-side validation and a dry-run API that shows deterministic routing for a sample batch.
jordan: Also log evaluated expressions to audit so we can reconstruct decisions for incidents.
anna: Great. I'll iterate and post refreshed mock + an exported checklist for eng + SRE integration tests. Thanks everyone.
